The Whale-Bone Bridge

Te Rewa Rewa Bridge, New Plymouth, Taranaki, New Zealand

NK
Nathan Kavumbura
Photographer

Curved white ribs framing the mountain beyond — one of the more striking pieces of public architecture in the country, built to echo a wave and a whale's spine at once.
